pattern_explanation: Both languages inherited these words from Latin, but over time their meanings drifted apart. The forms look nearly identical while the senses differ, so a learner who trusts the resemblance will pick the wrong English word.
false_friend_warning: This pair is a classic false friend: the Portuguese word that looks like 'pretend' actually means 'to intend', so a student who assumes a shared meaning will say the opposite of what they mean.
